name: In Search Of Treasures
storyline: This time, we take on the role of a young treasure hunter, Liroj, who, longing for a more prosperous life, decides to leave Khorinis in search of riches. He lands on a small island where the concept of treasure has a completely different meaning for the common folk…
summary:
Another story by Ingvers, the creator of 'The Adventures of Martin'. This time, you play as a young treasure hunter, Liroj, who, longing for a more prosperous life, decides to leave Khorinis in search of riches. He finds himself on a small island where the concept of "treasure" has completely different meanings for ordinary people. The author is known for his unique humor and surprising plot twists. This modification is no different!
Features:
- new locations and original quests
- russian voice over
- about 3 - 4 hours of gameplay
